title: Zoo Ops [Hard++]
tagline: Interview-grade distributed systems. The planet is on fire.

levels.label: Stampede
levels.title: PLANET-201 The viral question
levels.without: A hot answer expires and the whole crowd hits the model at once.
levels.with: One refresh per hot key, the crowd gets the stale answer meanwhile.

levels.label: Global limit
levels.title: PLANET-202 One limit for the whole planet
levels.without: Each region counts alone, so the swarm gets three budgets.
levels.with: One smooth budget per caller across every region.

levels.label: Tail latency
levels.title: PLANET-203 The long tail
levels.without: One busy replica makes every visitor wait.
levels.with: Late calls are hedged, replicas are capped, low priority is shed.

levels.label: Exactly once
levels.title: PLANET-204 Billed twice, or never
levels.without: A crash loses the event or charges the family twice.
levels.with: Every order is billed exactly once, whatever crashes.

levels.label: Tracing
levels.title: PLANET-205 The trace that stops at the queue
levels.without: Traces stop at the queue and the slow ones are thrown away.
levels.with: One trace end to end, and every slow or failing one is kept.

levels.label: Sharding
levels.title: PLANET-206 The registry outgrew its shards
levels.without: Adding a shard moves almost everything and reads fail.
levels.with: A fifth shard joins online and pages read a handful of rows.

levels.label: Saga
levels.title: PLANET-207 The half-finished adoption
levels.without: A refused van leaves a reserved kitten and a charged family.
levels.with: Failed adoptions are undone step by step, even after a crash.

levels.label: Partitions
levels.title: PLANET-208 Events out of order
levels.without: Events arrive out of order and a crash loses some.
levels.with: Ordered per animal, balanced consumers, nothing lost.

levels.label: Geo index
levels.title: PLANET-209 Dispatching keepers across the city
levels.without: Each escape scans twenty thousand keepers.
levels.with: The closest keepers are found from a few nearby cells.

levels.label: Leader
levels.title: PLANET-210 Two night watchmen
levels.without: Three schedulers feed the animals three times.
levels.with: One leader feeds, a woken zombie is fenced off.
